title: Bugs that only exist in time
blurb: The one plum register: a 67 ms commit nobody clicked on Replay QA's own Projects page, where 25 of 27 renders changed nothing a screen recording could see; a sync loop that fetched one pull-request list 258 times in under three minutes because it never saved its place; and, in a corner, a developer handing a recording to a critic until it says good.

shots.setting: the brand haze (deep plum, Replay red-pink, violet), an abstract studio, 2026, no time of day: the film's one dark register

lines.text: Some bugs only exist in time.
lines.direction: slower and lower than everything before it; the room has gone dark. Let 'in time' sit a fraction apart, not dramatic, just certain NARRATION (2026-10-14): take ran 235 wpm against 'slower and lower'; solo re-take at 0.98, the ellipsis sets 'in time' a fraction apart (text unchanged).
lines.spoken: Some bugs only exist... in time.

shots.visual: Blur dissolve out of ch04's paper into kit haze 'brand' (deep plum, a red-pink glow low left, violet high right), kit hairlines drifting slowly across at 8 % opacity. The stack of small dark '▶ recording' chips that ch04-s03 popped out of the run rows enters from the left edge at 50 % height, still stacked, and on the first beat flattens sideways into a horizontal FRAME RIBBON: a hairline track 1100 stage px wide at 62 % height, made of thin evenly spaced white ticks (each chip becomes a run of ticks). A bright red-pink hairline playhead (the rewind scrubber, kit icon 'rewind' as its tiny handle) enters at the right end and runs BACKWARDS, right to left, the ticks motion-blurring as it passes and settling sharp behind it. Above the ribbon, centred at 40 % height, kit kinetic type in Promo Sans light 64 px, white: 'Some bugs only exist' arrives word by word, blurring in on the spoken words; on 'only' the kit bracket braces open as an empty pair '{   }' after the line; on 'in' the words 'in time' arrive inside them and a red-pink colour sweep runs across 'in time' on 'time'; kit squareDots sit wide at the four corners of the bracket. The playhead reaches the left end exactly on 'time' and stops; the ribbon holds. Nothing product here: this is the turn.

shots.setting: Replay QA's bug page for the 67 ms commit (project Electric Forest PR 4650 Preview), floating in the brand haze; filed Sep 23, 2026, 5:56 PM

lines.text: Replay QA caught one in its own app.
lines.direction: a small, pleased reveal; the irony is gentle, not a joke; a touch of weight on 'own' NARRATION (2026-10-14): first take ran 224 wpm; solo re-takes at 0.98 with a comma and then a full stop both ran the beat in (225/217 wpm) and STT split 'Replay QA' unreliably (ReplayQ A / ReplayQA); the ellipsis take came back 'Replay cue A' (the seeded opening was identical across takes), so this take writes the letters as Q.A. for crisper letter-names, with the ellipsis beat before the reveal (text unchanged).
lines.spoken: Replay Q.A. caught one... in its own app.

lines.text: One update. Sixty-seven milliseconds. Four dropped frames.
lines.direction: 'One update.' sets the subject, light and quick; then two plain facts, evenly weighted; then stop and let the silence play

lines.text: No click. A background refresh re-rendered the project list.
lines.direction: 'No click.' quiet and a little amazed; the rest matter-of-fact, 'project list' plain (the ear's first and only mention of which list)

shots.visual: Still in the brand haze. The bug page tilts in as a floating RrwebScreen (no browser chrome, radius 14, soft plum shadow; tilt {x: 8, y: -10} settling flat by 'own'; NO cursor prop: the take's idle cursor sits at ≈ (830, 828) and must never be drawn). Take bug-react, mark open/report (3032) is NEVER shown: tape seeks to 3040 and runs to 3200 at real speed, then holds there (the chips row 'Open · Medium · React Rendering · Project default', the real title '67ms React commit at T=383.2s drops 4 frames on the Projects page: RTK-Query updates …' and the 'Replay' player card; never past ≈ 3217, where the player turns white). Crop {x: 500, y: 80, w: 940, h: 680} (recording px; excludes the left chat column with the masked login line, the header and the idle cursor below y 760); box ≈ 900 stage px wide (≈ 650 tall), centred, so it fits the 720 px stage with margin; zoom stays 1.0 for the whole shot (the title already reads at ≈ 30 stage px). No provenance label of ours on this page. THE PLAYER PLATE (verified on bug-react/003200.png: the dark player at recording ≈ {x: 558, y: 315, w: 820, h: 445} reads 'Loading replay…' at its centre, ≈ (968, 546)): from shot time 0 it is NEVER visible. From the first frame of the tilt, a matching dark plate (#121218, square corners, the player's own rounded top corners) is drawn INSIDE the same screen box, tilting with it, covering that rect through the crop; once the tilt has settled on 'own' it hands over to OUR SVG overlay plate at the same rect, flat, with a still, dim ribbon of 16.7 ms frame slots on it (thin rounded rectangles, white at 15 %). No loading text, spinner or player timestamp is ever drawn. On 'update' kit bracket braces snap around '67ms' in the title, drawn in OUR SVG overlay (not a zoom), and a hand-drawn red-pink underline runs under it. On 'Sixty-seven' the ribbon brightens to white at 30 % and starts sliding left at a steady rate, one soft clack per slot, and a small grey caption of ours appears under it: 'illustration · 16.7 ms frame budget'. On 'Four' a solid red-pink bar labelled '67 ms' drops across the ribbon covering exactly four slots, and those four slots go HOLLOW, outlined in coral, one per beat while the music is silent; the ribbon itself stops sliding during the silence: the ribbon with its four hollow slots alone carries 'Four dropped frames' (the braces stay on '67ms'). On 'No click.' the ribbon resumes sliding and a drawn cursor glyph appears on clear haze in the right margin beside the page (never over the screenshot), greyed, struck through with a red-pink hairline; it never moves. On 'background refresh' a faint pulse runs along the whole ribbon from left to right (the refresh nobody asked for); nothing else moves. The 'Open' chip stays visible at the top of the crop throughout: this bug is open.

shots.setting: the same bug page in the brand haze, 2026: our 27-render overlay, then a match cut down the page to its real Root Cause

lines.text: Twenty-five of twenty-seven renders changed nothing on screen.
lines.direction: spoken over the shatter, plain and a little quieter; 'nothing' carries it. A slight hold on 'changed' so its final -d is heard before 'nothing'. NARRATION (2026-10-14, round-1 review): STT heard 'renders change nothing'; re-take solo at 0.96 with a 0.07 s editorial break after 'changed', keep the take only if STT returns 'changed' (qa.expect).

lines.text: A screen recording can't see that. A time-travel recording can.
lines.direction: the pivot of the film: first sentence hushed and plain; then warm and sure on 'time-travel recording', a small smile on the last 'can'. Generic on purpose: no competitor named

shots.visual: Continuous with ch05-s02 (same crop, zoom 1.0, OUR player plate still covering the dark player rect ≈ {x: 558, y: 315, w: 820, h: 445}, so 'Loading replay…' never shows). TWO IDEAS ONLY: the grid, then the root cause. (1) At 0.1 s the red-pink 67 ms bar SHATTERS into 27 small squares (the renders), which fly into a neat 9 × 3 grid on the plate. On 'Twenty-five' twenty-five of them drain to hollow grey outlines and two stay solid red-pink, and a kinetic caption in Promo Sans, white, blurs in under the grid: '25 of 27 renders changed nothing' (a reported count [TIME-08]; the grid draws exactly that count, so no extra tag); on 'nothing' the hollow ones dim further. These are counts of renders, never a share of time: no pie, no percentages. On 'screen' a small pale VIDEO-FRAME outline (rounded rectangle, a tiny ▶ glyph at its lower left, a thin progress hairline along its bottom) drops over the grid: inside it only the 2 solid squares show; the 25 hollow renders leave no trace in it (a screen recording only keeps what changed on screen); it fades on 'that'. (2) Just before the second sentence ('A time-travel recording can.', cued on its first word so the label gets ≈ 2.7 s) a MATCH CUT down the same page to take bug-react FROZEN at tape 11300 (never run on: from ≈ 11400 the page scrolls and by 11736 the heading is behind the header; verified on bug-react/011300.png). Two RrwebScreens of that one frozen frame, no cursor prop, no chrome, on clear haze: an eyebrow crop of the real heading 'ROOT CAUSE' {x: 548, y: 102, w: 100, h: 22} shown ≈ 300 stage px wide (≈ 40 px letters) at upper left; under it the clause crop {x: 921, y: 130, w: 274, h: 24} ("`SidebarProjectList` trees are not memoized", the first body line of the real Root Cause) shown ≈ 1000 stage px wide (≈ 45 px text), centred. Kit bracket braces in OUR overlay snap around 'are not memoized' only (recording x ≈ 1090-1192 inside that crop). With the match cut a kinetic label in Promo Sans 44 px blurs in above: '{ root cause }', its colour sweep landing on the last 'can', and holds to the cut (≈ 2.2 s, so it reads): the film points at the root-cause analysis without claiming Replay QA fixed anything. This bug is open; no 'fixed' stamp ever touches it (its 'Open' chip was on screen through ch05-s02).

shots.setting: Replay QA's bug page for the live-sync loop (project Electric Forest, Local environment), floating in the brand haze; filed Sep 4, 2026, 2:16 AM

lines.text: Another bug: one list, fetched two hundred fifty-eight times in under three minutes.
lines.direction: 'Another bug:' a quick turn of the page ('bug' tells the ear this is a second bug, not another recording); 'one list' plain; the number said plainly, a little weight on 'fifty-eight'; 'in under three minutes' quicker, matter-of-fact: the time is the bug

lines.text: It never saved its place, so it kept starting over.
lines.direction: deadpan and even; 'It' is the list's sync loop; a small beat on 'place', then 'kept starting over' a touch wry, then let the snap-backs and the brightening play NARRATION (2026-10-14): take ran 258 wpm and ran through the comma; solo re-take at 0.98, the ellipsis is the beat on 'place' (text unchanged).
lines.spoken: It never saved its place... so it kept starting over.

shots.visual: Cut to a new floating RrwebScreen tilting in (tilt {x: 6, y: 10} settling flat by 'list'): take bug-sync, tape 1300 → report mark 1603 at real speed, then held; no cursor prop. Crop the TOP of the page only, ≈ {x: 520, y: 80, w: 900, h: 120} (recording px): the chips 'Fixed · Medium · Network Performance · Local' and the real title 'Live-sync loop re-fetches /api/repos/maple/reading-room/pulls 258 times with checkpoint never advancing past -1'; this strip sits in the upper third of the frame, ≈ 1100 stage px wide. On 'fifty-eight' zoom 1.0 → 1.6 about recording (1335, 137) (verified on bug-sync/001603.png: '258' sits at x ≈ 1255-1300 and 'times' runs to ≈ 1370 at y ≈ 137; the zoom keeps that point fixed, so the visible window is x ≈ 826-1388 and '258 times' stays whole), then eases back to 1.0 by 'never'. The title strip and chips stay pinned in the upper third for the whole shot. No Actual card and no provenance label in this shot. LOWER TWO-THIRDS, OUR OVERLAY: from 'fetched' a ribbon of tiny vertical request bars, one per tick, appears left to right fast as a counter (kit counter, Promo Sans 72 px, white) races 0 → 258; pinned above the ribbon, a small dark tag 'checkpoint −1' that NEVER moves or changes. On 'fifty-eight' the counter lands on 258 and stops dead, all 258 bars in place. On 'minutes' a drawn cursor glyph, greyed and struck through with a red-pink hairline (the same glyph as ch05-s02), appears on clear haze beside the ribbon with a small grey label of ours, '≈ 160 s · 2 clicks · no keypresses' (the requests ran for about 160 s; the take records 2 clicks, so nothing claims nobody touched it). On 'never' a small red-pink bookmark flag on the 'checkpoint −1' tag tries to step forward along the ribbon and snaps back to −1, three quick tries (the rewind playhead of ch05-s01 is NOT reused here: it means time travel, this means a loop that cannot keep its place), and the tag does not budge; on 'place' a red-pink underline runs under the 'checkpoint −1' tag (the place it never saved); on 'starting' every one of the 258 bars flashes back to its base and brightens at once (each request asked for everything since −1); hold on that through the 0.8 s tail so the snap-backs and the brightening register. Never the words 'reading-room app'; the 258 here never shares a frame with the Insights 258.
